channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Adventure Land - The Code MMORPG
item.description: An eternal indie MMORPG where your CODE does the grinding. Play manually or automate up to 4 characters with JavaScript. Hunt rare loot, craft equipment, and trade with real players. No coding experience needed! September 2026 brings anniversary rewards and a few surprises.

item.title: Assetto Corsa Competizione - GT2 Pack
item.description: The GT2 Pack introduces 6 new GT2 cars as well as the iconic european track, The Red Bull Ring Content Red Bull Ring KTM X-Bow GT2 Porsche 935 Maserati MC20 GT2 Mercedes-AMG GT2 Audi R8 LMS GT2 Porsche 911 GT2 RS Clubsport Evo

item.title: CRUMB Circuit Simulator
item.description: Powerful Realtime 3D Electronic Circuit Simulator

item.title: Dreamfall Chapters
item.description: The Final Cut is the ultimate collector's edition of Dreamfall Chapters, a story-driven 3D adventure about choice and consequence, set in parallel worlds: a cyberpunk vision of the future and a magical fantasy realm.

item.title: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
item.description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes is designed to bring players a modern take on a classic JRPG experience. Get ready to lead 100+ playable characters through a war-torn world only you can save.

item.title: EXAPUNKS
item.description: The year is 1997. You used to be a hacker, but now you have the phage. You made a deal: one hack, one dose. There’s nothing left to lose… except your life.

item.title: Grey Hack
item.description: Grey Hack is a massively multiplayer hacking simulator game. You're a hacker with full freedom to act as you wish on a vast network of procedurally generated computers.

item.title: JOY OF PROGRAMMING - Software Engineering Simulator
item.description: Use real Python code to automate machines, robots, drones and more: Program self-driving vehicles; crack passwords; apply machine learning; automate logistics; use image processing to guide missiles. Gain real coding skills and solve exciting bite-sized programming challenges.

item.title: Out and About
item.description: A cozy foraging adventure for anyone who loves the outdoors or wishes they knew it better. Every plant is real: learn to identify 100+ wild plants and fungi and cook 200+ real recipes, while helping a storm-struck town find its feet again.

item.title: Portal Knights
item.description: The world of Elysia needs YOU! Join this cooperative, 3D sandbox action RPG to level up your character, craft epic weapons, conquer enemies in real-time, and build almost anything! Craft your adventure. Forge your hero. Become the ultimate Portal Knight!

item.title: Retro Gadgets
item.description: Retro Gadgets is a sandbox where you build, code, and customize gadgets inspired by old-school electronics.

item.title: SHENZHEN I/O
item.description: BUILD CIRCUITS. WRITE CODE. RTFM.

item.title: Sniper Elite
item.description: As World War II draws to a close, the first covert battles of the Cold War begin. Caught in the life and death struggle between Soviets and Germans in war-torn Berlin, you control the fate of a lone American OSS Sniper.

item.title: Sniper Elite 5 : Landing Force Mission and Weapon Pack
item.description: Deploy to the South of France where enemy forces have commandeered an island off the coast of Marseille to house a gargantuan gun battery.

item.title: Sniper Elite 5: Kraken Awakes Mission, Weapon and Skin Pack
item.description: The final content drop for Season Pass Two delivers an incredible new mission called Kraken Awakes that brings the story of Sniper Elite 5 to a close.

item.title: Sniper Elite 5: Rough Landing Mission and Weapon Pack
item.description: Included in this pack: • Rough Landing Mission • Mosin Nagant rifle • Sjogren shotgun

item.title: Swan Song
item.description: Swan Song is a cozy puzzle game that invites you to slow down, listen, and reflect. Set inside a magical music box, each puzzle asks players to place notes on a musical scale. When you turn the key, the composition plays, activating platforms and opening paths that guide a small swan to safety.

item.title: The Bloodline
item.description: The Bloodline is a sandbox adventure RPG that lets you play your way. Reforge bonds between kingdoms, explore the wilds, craft and plan adventures and wield mighty weapons or magic as you prepare for what is to come…

item.title: The House of Da Vinci 3
item.description: The grand finale to The House of Da Vinci trilogy is here! Solve numerous new puzzles and mind benders and explore new mystifying locations of ravishing beauty.

item.title: while True: learn()
item.description: You're a programmer. Your cat is a better one. Solve visual puzzles built from real machine learning ideas, from decision trees to neural networks, to create a cat-to-human translator. Take freelance jobs, upgrade your rig, gamble on startups, dress up the cat. No coding required, curiosity is.

item.title: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night
item.description: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night is an exploration-focused, side-scroller action RPG by Koji Igarashi. Play as Miriam, an orphan scarred by an alchemist's curse that slowly crystallizes her body. Battle through a demon-infested castle and defeat its master to save yourself, and all of humanity!

item.title: Borderlands®4 - C4SH the Rogue
item.description: Play as the all-new Vault Hunter, C4SH the Rogue, and wield his unique Action Skills and skill trees across all of Kairos. With a knack for doling out damage and racking up kills in quick succession, C4SH always has an edge no matter the odds.

item.title: Chop Chop Inc.
item.description: Build your own furniture empire after getting fired from Furnox Corp 🖕. Chop down trees, process wood, automate your growing production lines and sell clever furniture sets for bonus cash. Explore a handcrafted world packed with weirdos, secrets and trees begging for violence.

item.title: Drag'n Wash
item.description: Enjoy a narrative involving 3 male dragons. Wash them, chat with them, touch them, and more! A 3D dragon washing experience.

item.title: Duskers
item.description: Pilot drones into derelict spaceships to find the means to survive and piece together how the universe became a giant graveyard.

item.title: Effulgence RPG
item.description: Effulgence RPG is a party-based RPG where symbols form 3D visuals. Enemies are more than obstacles - they ARE the resource 💀. Destroy them to forge better gear!

item.title: Farm Together 2
item.description: Grow your own farm all by yourself, or cooperate with your friends in the long awaited sequel to the cozy, relaxing farming experience!

item.title: Forsworn
item.description: Stack game-breaking synergies until your party can slay gods. Command a party of heroes, forge powerful synergies, and level them up across runs in this turn-based tactics roguelite. Battle the gods solo or in co-op, where defeat is just another beginning.

item.title: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics
item.description: Discover the story of the Aristeia world in single-player or storm into PvP battles! Turn-based battles, 12 heroes, varied arenas, deckbuilding with dozens of tactical cards. Assemble the perfect team, use hundreds of insane combos, and become HexaDome champion. And bring a friend!

item.title: MORDHAU
item.description: MORDHAU is a multiplayer medieval slasher. Create your mercenary and fight in brutal battles where you will experience fast paced combat, castle sieges, cavalry charges, and more.

item.title: Tech Support: Error Unknown
item.description: Things are not what they seem at your new tech support specialist job. While resolving customer issues, you soon find yourself in the middle of a conspiracy. Will you side with your employer, join a rogue hacktivist group bent on destroying them, assist the police or stand alone?

item.title: The Last Campfire
item.description: The Last Campfire is an adventure, a story of a lost ember trapped in a puzzling place, searching for meaning and a way home.

item.title: Turing Complete
item.description: Learn CPU architecture with puzzles

item.title: Black Gold: Oil Drilling Simulator
item.description: Step into the grit of the early 20th-century oil boom. Build your drilling empire from the dirt up chop timber, maintain rusty machinery, and manage a rugged crew. Strike black gold, overcome ruthless crises, and turn raw earth into an unimaginable fortune. The rush begins now.

item.title: Bobo Bay
item.description: Bobo Bay is a cozy pet simulation game where you raise Bobos day by day. Train them, accessorize them, mash (breed) new generations, compete in events, explore randomized islands, improve the town, and discover new species as they grow.

item.title: Borderlands®4 - Story Pack 1: Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned
item.description: Play as the all-new Vault Hunter, C4SH, and explore the blood-soaked mysteries of the Whispering Glacier in this cosmic-horror adventure! Featuring new missions, activities, loot, and a terrifying new region.

item.title: Ex Sanguis
item.description: Bleed the world back to life in a series of tactical, turn-based bloodbaths! Lead your STILLAE, elite warriors in the fight to save a dying world from the forces of STASIS. Slay foes, kick them back on the timeline, and trigger chain events where elegance and blood flow as one.

item.title: Roguecraft DX
item.description: Roguecraft DX is a turn-based roguelike set in a Lovecraftian dungeon that rebuilds itself every run. Fight tentacled horrors and scary chickens, and free a caged badger who'll fetch loot for you. Compact runs that respect your time: die, learn, and dive right back in!

item.title: Shady job
item.description: A co-op adventure game. The mafia wants to get rid of a body. You’re construction workers. Your job: carry a body bag to the top of a skyscraper. Bury it in concrete. Two problems. First: You have to build the way up. Second: The body’s not dead. It fights back.

item.title: Taiji
item.description: Solve puzzle panels and uncover the meaning of the symbols within. Explore a dense world where secrets are hidden in plain sight.

item.title: Welcome to Elderfield
item.description: Welcome to Elderfield, a cozy horror RPG with hand-drawn art and dark lofi music. Manage your farm, befriend or romance the locals, investigate mysteries, decorate your home, fight terrifying creatures, fish, cook, seek the Old Gods, die in your sleep, and more... There's lots to do in Elderfield!

item.title: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall
item.description: Black Friday Janitor is a organization game that hands you the biggest clean up job of the year. Over 30,000 things to tidy up: misplaced products to return to their correct spots, rubbish to collect, dirt to scrub, and fallen furniture to set back upright. Don't expect to finish it all in one go!

item.title: Dungeon Brawls
item.description: Dungeon Brawls is an action roguelike game that supports 4-player co-op. Choose from dozens of heroes and freely combine hundreds of skills and relics. Team up with friends, take on the challenge, and battle through waves of enemies in intense, action-packed combat!

item.title: Golden Swirl
item.description: Golden Swirl is a dark fantasy, semi-real-time action deckbuilder. Master tactical movement to dodge fierce attacks while managing your hand. Fully voiced with custom heroes, fine-tune your deck, relics, and runes to repel the Swirl. Can you survive the madness?

item.title: HimaNatsu: Of Churches, Sunflowers, and Long Summers
item.description: The classic visual novel 'HimaNatsu' from the critically acclaimed developer Makura is available in English for the first time! Weave a cheerful yet sometimes painful tale of promises and redemption together with the Oboshiro Choir Squad in this never-ending summer vacation.

item.title: Monster Alchemy
item.description: Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.
